items.period: Shang oracle-script style; the file does not identify a dated individual inscription.
items.tradition: Oracle-bone script style (甲骨文), modern vector redraw
items.caption: This oracle-script-style redraw of 木 is consistent with the interpretation of the graph as a picture of a whole tree.
items.alt: A narrow black glyph with a long central vertical stroke, three angled upper branches, and spreading strokes at the base.
items.selection_reason: It illustrates the whole-tree interpretation. The visible strokes alone do not establish which represent branches or roots.
items.rights: Commons states the SVG representation is public domain for any purpose; attribution is appreciated but not required. The page also records historical courtesy/permission for source material.

items.period: Bronze-script style; the file does not identify a particular inscription or narrower period.
items.tradition: Chinese bronze inscription script style (金文), modern vector redraw
items.caption: This bronze-script-style redraw shows another standalone form of 木, also interpreted as a whole-tree picture.
items.alt: A black glyph with a central vertical stroke, three upper prongs, and broad diagonal strokes extending from the middle and base.
items.selection_reason: It adds a distinct script-style example for the whole-tree explanation; it does not establish a dated graphic sequence with the oracle-style redraw.
items.rights: Commons states the SVG representation is public domain for any purpose; attribution is appreciated but not required. The page also records historical courtesy/permission for source material.

limitations.text: Both images are modern redraws, not artifact photographs or depictions tied to specific dated inscriptions. Their shapes alone cannot establish a sequence of graphic change or assign each stroke to a particular branch or root.
